occupation_context.rationale: Aerobridge is a drone fleet management platform used by UAS operators, fleet managers, aviation compliance officers, and operations staff who need to manage aircraft registries, regulatory compliance, flight planning, and mission scheduling.

new_tasks.name: update_operator_authorizations
new_tasks.professional_relevance: UAS compliance manager updating operator regulatory authorizations when company expands service scope
features_tested: Discovering correct operator among multiple companies
new_tasks.hardness_rationale: Requires: (1) navigating to a specific operator (not obvious which), (2) managing M2M many-to-many fields in Django admin, (3) finding and selecting the right dropdown value for operator_type

new_tasks.name: create_survey_mission
new_tasks.professional_relevance: Flight operations manager creating a new survey mission with flight plan + operation using the correct drone asset
features_tested: FlightOperation creation with FK to new plan
Multi-entity dependency (plan must exist before operation)
new_tasks.hardness_rationale: Requires: (1) creating two inter-dependent records, (2) entering valid GeoJSON, (3) selecting correct drone from 2 similar options, (4) linking operation to the new plan not the existing one

new_tasks.name: register_aircraft_model_chain
new_tasks.professional_relevance: Fleet manager onboarding a new drone model type from procurement, creating model spec + assembly + aircraft registration in sequence
features_tested: Aircraft creation with final_assembly FK to new assembly
new_tasks.hardness_rationale: Requires: (1) 3-step dependent chain (model→assembly→aircraft), (2) correct category enum for ROTORCRAFT, (3) selecting the newly-created assembly from a dropdown showing model-based description

new_tasks.name: setup_new_operator_company
new_tasks.professional_relevance: Business development manager onboarding a new drone service company as a licensed operator with initial activity authorizations
features_tested: Company record creation with correct role (Operator) and country (IN)
Operator record creation linked to company
new_tasks.hardness_rationale: Requires: (1) two admin sections (Registry→Companies, Registry→Operators), (2) correct role and country dropdowns, (3) selecting the new company in Operator form, (4) assigning M2M activities

new_tasks.name: register_aircraft_with_detail
new_tasks.professional_relevance: Fleet registrar completing the full aircraft lifecycle: physical registration with national authority, then scheduling its first operation
features_tested: FlightOperation creation using the new aircraft
new_tasks.hardness_rationale: Requires: (1) aircraft + detail + operation (3 separate admin sections), (2) registration mark with specific format, (3) linking the operation to the newly-created aircraft
